patterns.note: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background with minimal overlay text and a single call to action, creating an immersive initial experience.
A high-contrast color palette is used, prominently featuring a vibrant lime green as a primary accent against stark black and off-white backgrounds and text.
Large, bold, sans-serif typography is used for key brand elements and section titles (e.g., 'DUST', 'Hightail®'), creating a strong, industrial aesthetic.
The site employs a standard vertical scroll, where the full-bleed hero video scrolls out of view to reveal subsequent content sections without complex parallax or reveal animations.
The footer is highly distinctive, featuring a very large, bold brand logo ('DUST') on the left, contrasting with smaller, functional links and a prominent pre-order call-to-action on the right.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-bleed video as the hero background, which scrolls off-screen with standard vertical scrolling to reveal the content below. Content sections appear directly as they scroll into view, without any scroll-triggered fade-in or slide-up animations. Buttons and interactive elements likely use CSS keyframe animations for subtle hover states or loading indicators.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, clean body text and uppercase navigation labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied to buttons and input fields, providing a soft touch to an otherwise sharp design.
design_tokens.spacing: The hero section is airy, providing ample negative space around the product. Subsequent content sections maintain a balanced density, while the footer is visually dense but well-structured.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold and energetic use of a high-contrast color palette, particularly the striking lime green accent against black and off-white. This, combined with the large, industrial-style typography for brand elements, creates a unique and memorable brand identity that feels both modern and powerful.
